policy: Primary author/dataset documentation only; compatibility review is not an accuracy experiment

sources.name: DR-SPAAM / DROW3
sources.facts: 2D LiDAR person detectors with pretrained checkpoints and temporal inference; original ROS wrapper is ROS1.
sources.local_status: Existing pinned JRDB checkpoint ran on CUDA but local quality gate FAIL; not rerun or promoted.
sources.decision: Keep separate LiDAR comparator; current collision cylinders and scan profile are a domain mismatch.

sources.name: FROG / LFE-PPN
sources.facts: Real 2D range dataset; paper table records 35 cm mounting, 720 points, 180-degree FoV.
sources.decision: Useful independent LiDAR dataset track; cannot substitute for missing depth or 12 cm articulated-leg observations.

sources.name: LFE ROS2 deployment
sources.facts: Author-tested environment lists Ubuntu22.04/ROS2Humble, CUDA12.1, ONNX Runtime1.16.3.
sources.decision: No verified Jazzy binary compatibility; no .deb/system changes. Standalone engine/container would need separate testing.

sources.name: SDT depth dataset
sources.facts: 40k synthetic + 8k real depth/thermal images, person boxes and poses, elevated camera.
sources.decision: Depth-only subset potentially useful; calibration/units/partial-view and box-to-patch label purity must be checked. Not downloaded or declared ready.

sources.name: Synthetic depth robot person detection
sources.facts: Authors train modality-specific detectors on randomized synthetic scenes and evaluate real warehouse observations.
sources.decision: Supports diverse depth training strategy; not a verified plug-in pretrained checkpoint for this robot.

sources.name: PointNet architecture reference
sources.facts: Learns point-set features with permutation invariance. Original implementation tested Python2.7/TensorFlow1.0.1.
sources.decision: Use a small independently written Torch-style candidate head, not legacy installation or generic object weights as person weights.

data_status: No external dataset downloaded, no new independent real-data metrics
candidate: high-recall 2D proposal provider + small learned XYZ point encoder; 3D coordinates retained, current 3D clustering not selected
candidate_limits: Cannot recover people absent/merged in 2D proposals
Generalization requires new scene/morphology and verified labels
LiDAR evidence remains optional/unknown when unsupported
